purpose: Independent combinatorial check of the normalized four-particle Fock-state factor for a normal-ordered quartic creation vertex
limitations: This checks only the Bose combinatorial factor in the vacuum-to-four-particle vertex matrix element.
It does not validate the Keldysh contour derivation, pulse integral, momentum sums, renormalization, or the full two-particle spectrum.
No physical simulation or numerical spectrum was computed.
